title: How Claude Watermarks AI-Generated Text
excerpt: A 48-minute video walkthrough of token sampling, watermark detection, and removal

ai.summary: Claude introduced a watermarking technique that embeds a subtle pattern into generated text, and a 48‑minute video demonstrates token sampling, watermark detection, and removal.
ai.why: Developers can use the watermark to verify authenticity of Claude outputs or to detect AI‑generated content in their applications.
